'''Rashal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] residing on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Republic forces.

==Equipment==
He dual wielded a single-bladed and a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]].
